issue_context.title: Refine cancel in test
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
We use `admin.CancelJobs(txn, test.jobIDs)` in test to cancel a DDL job.
The code is a little complex and doesn't compatible with the new DDL framework.
We should use SQL statement "admin cancel ddl job" to achieve the same goal.

review_comments:
Why can't this DDL be canceled? The state is public.
